gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility is already elevated — realized vol sits in the top fifth of the past year, so the move is underway, not loading. This is the opposite of a coiled squeeze: the quiet entry is already gone. A late / heads-up read, never a standalone signal.

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

top.title: Scout Clean Energy’s Nimbus Wind Farm Achieves Commercial Operations, Supporting Microsoft’s Clean Energy Portfolio
top.summary: Scout Clean Energy announced that its 183 MW Nimbus Wind Farm in Arkansas has achieved commercial operations. The project will power over 40,000 homes annually, contribute $31 million in property taxes to Carroll County, and has signed a power purchase agreement with Microsoft for electricity offtake.

top.title: FHS Living präsentiert erste Speaker für die Veranstaltung in Paris – Hotelisierung verändert Europas Immobilienbranche
top.summary: FHS Living, Europe's investment forum for the living sector, has announced its first speakers for the Paris edition on February 23-24, 2027. The forum brings together investors, developers, and operators in Europe's living segment, focusing on hotelization of real estate. Major participants include Brookfield, Nuveen Real Estate, Aroundtown, Accor One Living, and others. European living segment investments rose 22% to €62.2 billion in 2025, with projections exceeding €70 billion for 2026.

top.title: FHS Living dévoile les premiers intervenants de son édition parisienne, alors que l’hôtellisation transforme le secteur immobilier européen
top.summary: FHS Living, Europe's investment forum for residential and alternative living sectors, has announced its first speakers for the Paris edition scheduled for February 23-24, 2027. The event will bring together major real estate investors, developers, and operators to discuss the 'hotelisation' trend—applying hospitality codes to non-traditional real estate assets. Confirmed participants include Brookfield, Nuveen Real Estate, Aroundtown, Accor One Living, and others. European residential sector investments grew 22% to €62.2 billion in 2025, with projections exceeding €70 billion in 2026.

top.title: VALLOUREC ALIGNE SA STRUCTURE FINANCIERE AVEC SON PROFIL  « INVESTMENT GRADE » GRACE A UNE NOUVELLE LIGNE DE CREDIT RENOUVELABLE MULTIDEVISES DE 750 MILLIONS D’EUROS
top.summary: Vallourec announced the signing of a new €750 million multi-currency revolving credit facility (RCF) with a five-year maturity and two one-year extension options. The new facility replaces an existing €550 million RCF and a $350 million asset-backed lending facility, offering more favorable terms and reduced financing costs. The facility was coordinated by BNP Paribas and Natixis CIB with a syndicate of 13 international banks and was significantly oversubscribed, demonstrating strong support from lenders.

The five-year facility, coordinated by BNP Paribas and Natixis CIB with 13 international banks, features improved terms and lower financing costs, reflecting strong lender confidence in the company's financial profile and investment-grade status.

top.title: INVESTOR ALERT: RGRD Law Announces that Webull Corporation (BULL) Investors with Substantial Losses May Seek to Lead Class Action Lawsuit Before December 7, 2026 Deadline
top.summary: Robbins Geller Rudman & Dowd LLP announces a class action lawsuit against Webull Corporation, alleging the company made false statements about its independence from China. The lawsuit claims Webull misrepresented its operations as primarily U.S.-based when in fact 62% of its workforce and core operations are tied to the People's Republic of China. A House Select Committee investigation corroborated these findings, leading to a 19% stock price decline. Investors with substantial losses can seek lead plaintiff status before December 7, 2026.

top.title: Bronstein, Gewirtz & Grossman LLC Urges Webull Corporation Investors to Act: Class Action Filed Alleging Investor Harm
top.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against Webull Corporation alleging that the company made false and misleading statements about its operations. The complaint claims Webull misrepresented its independence from China by overstating its U.S.-based operations while concealing that its software development, data pipelines, and core engineering depend on PRC-based personnel and infrastructure. Investors who purchased Webull securities between April 26, 2025 and October 6, 2026 are encouraged to join the case, with a lead plaintiff deadline of December 7, 2026.

top.title: Bronstein, Gewirtz & Grossman LLC Urges Doximity, Inc. Investors to Act: Class Action Filed Alleging Investor Harm
top.summary: Multiple class action lawsuits have been filed against Doximity, Webull, and UP Fintech for alleged securities fraud and violations of federal securities laws. Doximity is accused of overstating its Newsfeed's revenue impact, losing market share to competitors, and misrepresenting its advertising practices. Investors who purchased securities during specified class periods are encouraged to seek recovery.

top.title: Webull (BULL) Faces Securities Class Action Amid House Committee Findings: “Profound Gap” Between Company Statements and Operational Reality – HBSS
top.summary: Webull Corporation faces a federal securities class action lawsuit alleging misrepresentations about its business structure and China operations. A House Select Committee report confirmed that Webull's data practices expose U.S. investors to PRC surveillance risks, its governance is dominated by PRC-linked control, and its subsidiary accepted conditional CCP government funding. The stock fell approximately 19% to $5.89 per share following the committee's findings. The class period runs from April 26, 2025 to October 6, 2026, with a lead plaintiff deadline of December 7, 2026.

top.title: Perspective Therapeutics Presents Encouraging Incremental Data and Analyses from Phase 1/2a Trial of [212Pb]Bamzireotide Navoxetan (VMT-α-NET) in Advanced SSTR2 Expressing NETs
top.summary: Perspective Therapeutics announced positive Phase 1/2a trial data for bamzireotide navoxetan (VMT-α-NET) in neuroendocrine tumor patients. The drug demonstrated durable disease control with 75% progression-free survival at 18 months in GEP-NET patients with SSTR2-positive target lesions, compared to 65% for an approved competitor. The treatment was well-tolerated with no dose-limiting toxicities or treatment discontinuations. The company plans an end-of-Phase 2 meeting with the FDA in Q1 2027 and aims to initiate Phase 3 studies in 2027.

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. top.title: Financial institutions accelerate transition to multi-agent AI in drive for bottom-line value
top.summary: According to Capgemini's World Cloud Report for Financial Services 2027, 59% of financial institutions are piloting or deploying multi-agent AI systems, but only 10% have achieved enterprise-wide orchestration. Banks and insurers are increasingly prioritizing business outcomes over AI efficiency, with 90% planning intelligent model routing to optimize costs. Over half prefer hyperscalers as cloud partners for multi-agent governance, though only 5% have fully operationalized agentic AI at enterprise scale.

top.title: DAVA SHAREHOLDER NOTICE: Endava plc Investors with Substantial Losses Have Opportunity to Lead the Endava Class Action Lawsuit
top.summary: Endava (NYSE: DAVA) is facing a securities class action lawsuit after its stock plummeted 25% on September 22, 2026, following disclosure of accounting problems and management issues. The company's CFO was placed on administrative leave, and an internal investigation was initiated after auditors raised concerns about accounting treatment of customer and supplier agreements. The lawsuit covers investors who purchased Endava securities between September 4, 2025 and September 21, 2026, with a lead plaintiff deadline of November 30, 2026.

top.title: DAVA IMPORTANT DEADLINE: ROSEN, RECOGNIZED INVESTOR COUNSEL, Encourages Endava plc Investors with Losses in Excess of $100K to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action – DAVA
top.summary: Multiple securities class action lawsuits have been filed against Endava plc, Fluence Energy Inc., AST SpaceMobile Inc., Lincoln Educational Services Corp., and Gildan Activewear Inc. for alleged materially false statements, misleading disclosures, and internal control failures. Investors with losses exceeding $100,000 are encouraged to join the class actions before respective deadlines.

top.title: DEADLINE ALERT for D-Wave Quantum, Inc. (QBTS) and FuelCell Energy, Inc. (FCEL): The Law Offices of Howard G. Smith Reminds Investors of Opportunity to Lead Securities Fraud Class Actions
top.summary: Securities class action lawsuits have been filed against D-Wave Quantum, Inc. and FuelCell Energy, Inc. for alleged false and misleading statements. D-Wave is accused of overstating business and financial prospects during February-August 2026, with a lead plaintiff deadline of December 15, 2026. FuelCell Energy faces allegations of inadequate manufacturing capacity and undisclosed production issues under a CEPA agreement, with a lead plaintiff deadline of November 10, 2026.

top.title: FCEL IMPORTANT DEADLINE: ROSEN, A LEADING NATIONAL FIRM, Encourages FuelCell Energy, Inc. Investors with Losses in Excess of $100K to Secure Counsel Before Important November 10 Deadline in Securities Class Action - FCEL
top.summary: FuelCell Energy, Inc. (NASDAQ: FCEL) faces a securities class action lawsuit alleging the company made false and misleading statements regarding its manufacturing capacity under a capital equipment purchase agreement with Fit Energy. The lawsuit claims FuelCell's production rates were slower than expected, leading to higher costs and manufacturing overhead expenses. Investors who purchased FCEL securities between June 24, 2026 and September 1, 2026 may be eligible for compensation, with a November 10, 2026 deadline to serve as lead plaintiff.

top.title: BIDU FINAL DEADLINE: ROSEN, SKILLED INVESTOR COUNSEL, Encourages Baidu, Inc. Investors With Losses in Excess of $100K to Secure Counsel Before Important November 13 Deadline in Securities Class Action - BIDU
top.summary: Rosen Law Firm is announcing multiple securities class action lawsuits against Baidu, FuelCell Energy, Fervo Energy, Coastal Financial Corporation, and Bank of America. The lawsuits allege false statements, misleading disclosures, and mismanagement of business operations. Investors with significant losses are encouraged to join the class actions before respective deadlines.

Additionally, Novartis initiated Phase 2 studies of partnered program MRT-6160 in Sjögren's disease and psoriatic arthritis, triggering $87.5 million in milestone payments. The company maintains a strong cash position of $582.6 million, expected to support operations into 2029.

top.title: HUTCHMED Announces Sovleplenib Granted US FDA Orphan Drug Designation for Autoimmune Hemolytic Anemia
top.summary: HUTCHMED announced that the US FDA has granted Orphan Drug Designation to sovleplenib for treating autoimmune hemolytic anemia (AIHA), marking the second orphan designation for the drug following its recent designation for primary immune thrombocytopenia (ITP). The designation provides 7 years of US market exclusivity upon approval, along with other development incentives. NDAs for sovleplenib are currently under regulatory review in China for primary ITP and warm AIHA.

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options lean down

reasons.en: puts richer than calls by -2.9 vol pts vs peers — protection strongly bid
reasons.zh: 看跌比看涨贵 -2.9 个波动点（相对同业） — 保护性看跌被大力买入

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

Investors who purchased securities between October 16, 2024 and December 29, 2025 may be eligible to recover losses, with a lead plaintiff deadline of December 14, 2026.

top.title: Vuoden 2026 kolmannen neljänneksen osavuosikatsaus
top.summary: IQM Quantum Computers reported strong Q3 2026 results with order backlog growing 52% year-to-date to €102.5 million. The company secured €42.2 million in new orders including a major €33 million LUMI-IQ Halocene contract with CSC. Revenue grew 51% to €8.9 million, and the company reaffirmed full-year 2026 guidance of €65-75 million in order intake and €42-47 million in revenue. IQM has sold 31 quantum computers globally with 17 delivered and 17 in production.

top.title: Opus Genetics Completes Dosing in Cohort 2 of Phase 1/2 Clinical Trial of OPGx-BEST1 Gene Therapy for Inherited Retinal Diseases
top.summary: Opus Genetics announced completion of dosing in Cohort 2 of its BIRD-1 Phase 1/2 clinical trial for OPGx-BEST1, a gene therapy for BEST1-related retinal diseases. The higher-dose cohort enrolled 11 participants (exceeding the target of 5) at 4.5 × 10⁹ vg/eye. Topline three-month data is expected in Q1 2027, with potential Phase 3 pivotal trial dosing anticipated in H2 2027. Cohort 1 showed favorable safety and clinically meaningful improvements in visual function across all five participants.

top.title: Monte Rosa Therapeutics Announces Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Business Updates
top.summary: Monte Rosa Therapeutics announced positive Phase 1 results for MRT-8102, showing significant NEK7 degradation and reduction in cardiovascular disease markers with safety comparable to placebo. The company plans to initiate three Phase 2 studies in gout, coronary artery disease, and hidradenitis suppurativa. The company maintains a strong cash position of $582.6 million, expected to support operations into 2029.

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility is already elevated — realized vol sits in the top fifth of the past year, so the move is underway, not loading. This is the opposite of a coiled squeeze: the quiet entry is already gone. A late / heads-up read, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动率已处于高位 — 实现波动率位于过去一年前五分之一，行情已在进行，而非蓄势。这与压缩蓄势相反：安静的入场点已过。属偏晚的提示读数，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options lean down

reasons.en: puts richer than calls by -4.1 vol pts vs peers — protection strongly bid
reasons.zh: 看跌比看涨贵 -4.1 个波动点（相对同业） — 保护性看跌被大力买入

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options lean up

reasons.en: calls richer than puts by +2.4 vol pts vs peers — strong informed bullish lean
reasons.zh: 看涨比看跌贵 +2.4 个波动点（相对同业） — 知情资金强烈偏多

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

top.title: Molecular Partners Presents New Preclinical Data for Next-Generation T Cell Engager MP0632 at SITC 2026
top.summary: Molecular Partners announced preclinical data for MP0632, a logic-gated Switch-DARPin T cell engager targeting MSLN and EpCAM co-expressing tumors. The data demonstrates potent tumor cell killing comparable to clinical-stage benchmarks with improved safety profiles and no detectable impact on healthy tissues. The company plans to advance MP0632 into IND-enabling studies for solid tumors including ovarian, endometrial, lung, and pancreatic cancers.

top.title: Molecular Partners to Present on DLL3-Targeting Radio-DARPin MP0712 at 2026 SNMMI Theranostics Conference and NACLC 2026
top.summary: Molecular Partners AG announced it will present data on its lead Radio-DARPin candidate MP0712, co-developed with Orano Med, at two major scientific conferences in November and December 2026. The presentations will include initial dose escalation data from a Phase 1/2a study in small cell lung cancer and other DLL3-expressing solid tumors, with efficacy data expected in the coming months.

top.title: SHAREHOLDER ALERT: Bronstein Gewirtz & Grossman, LLC Announces Class Action Against Millrose Properties, Inc. (NYSE: MRP) — Investors Who Suffered Losses Are Encouraged to Contact the Firm
top.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against Millrose Properties, Inc. (NYSE: MRP) alleging securities fraud. The complaint claims that Millrose failed to disclose that it would purchase $200 million in properties from Lennar Corporation and lease them at a loss, contrary to its stated business objectives. Investors who purchased MRP securities between February 7, 2025 and October 2, 2026 may be eligible to recover losses, with a lead plaintiff deadline of December 8, 2026.

top.title: Kirby McInerney LLP Alerts Investors Who Acquired Millrose Properties, Inc MRP Securities Between February 7, 2025 and October 2, 2026 of Pending Lawsuit
top.summary: A federal securities class action lawsuit has been filed against Millrose Properties, Inc. (NYSE: MRP) for allegedly making false statements about its business operations. The company claimed it would not have tenants on its properties, but instead purchased $200 million worth of homes from parent company Lennar and leased them at a loss. The revelation caused Millrose shares to decline 8.5% on October 5, 2026. The lead plaintiff deadline is December 8, 2026.

top.title: MILLROSE ALERT: Bragar Eagel & Squire, P.C. Announces that a Class Action Lawsuit Has Been Filed Against Millrose Properties, Inc. and Encourages Investors to Contact the Firm
top.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against Millrose Properties, Inc. (NYSE:MRP) in the U.S. District Court for the Southern District of Florida. The complaint alleges that Millrose made materially false and misleading statements regarding its business objectives, failing to disclose that it would enter lease agreements with tenants, purchase $200 million in properties from Lennar, and lease those properties at a loss. Investors who purchased Millrose securities between February 7, 2025 and October 2, 2026 can apply to be lead plaintiff by December 8, 2026.

top.summary: NewLake Capital Partners announced Q3 2026 financial results with total revenue of $12.0 million and net income of $4.2 million. The company strengthened its balance sheet by repaying $7.6 million in debt, ending the quarter with no outstanding debt and $17.9 million in cash. Despite a 4.5% revenue decline compared to Q3 2025 due to three properties becoming available for lease, the company acquired dispensary properties in Kentucky, Michigan, and Kentucky post-quarter end, positioning itself for growth as the cannabis regulatory landscape matures.

top.title: Faster Permitting Paths Put Gold-Antimony Projects on Both Sides of the Pacific in Focus
top.summary: With China's antimony export suspension set to expire in November 2026 and global antimony prices elevated, governments in New Zealand and the United States are accelerating approvals for gold-antimony projects. RUA GOLD submitted its substantive application for the Auld Creek project in New Zealand under the Fast-track Approvals Act, targeting mid-2027 approvals. Nova Minerals received final permits for its Alaska antimony project with $43.4 million in Department of War funding, targeting 2027 production. United States Antimony Corporation began mining operations at Nolan Creek, while Perpetua Resources secured $40 million in additional U.S. Army funding for tungsten evaluation at Stibnite. Alkane Resources reported strong Q1 FY27 production of 39,823 ounces of gold and 396 tonnes of antimony.

A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

top.title: SHAREHOLDER ALERT: Bronstein Gewirtz & Grossman, LLC Announces Class Action Against O-I Glass, Inc. (NYSE: OI) — Investors Who Suffered Losses Are Encouraged to Contact the Firm

The complaint claims the company failed to disclose delays in achieving targeted savings, higher-than-expected expenses, operational disruptions, and competitive pressures affecting European operations. Investors who purchased OI securities between March 14, 2025 and July 28, 2026 may be eligible to recover losses, with a lead plaintiff deadline of December 28, 2026.

The approval is supported by clinical data from Pharming's pediatric clinical program.

top.title: Faster Permitting Paths Put Gold-Antimony Projects on Both Sides of the Pacific in Focus
top.summary: With China's antimony export suspension set to expire in November 2026 and global antimony prices elevated, governments in New Zealand and the United States are accelerating approvals for gold-antimony projects. RUA GOLD submitted its substantive application for the Auld Creek project in New Zealand under the Fast-track Approvals Act, targeting mid-2027 approvals. Nova Minerals received final permits for its Alaska antimony project with $43.4 million in Department of War funding, targeting 2027 production. United States Antimony Corporation began mining operations at Nolan Creek, while Perpetua Resources secured $40 million in additional U.S. Army funding for tungsten evaluation at Stibnite. Alkane Resources reported strong Q1 FY27 production of 39,823 ounces of gold and 396 tonnes of antimony.

top.title: Swedbank Provides EUR 130 Million in Financing to Akropolis Group
top.summary: Akropolis Group, a leading Baltic real estate developer, has secured a EUR 130 million seven-year credit facility with Swedbank to refinance its previous loan. The agreement reflects strong financial performance, with H1 2026 consolidated revenue reaching EUR 81.6 million (up 29%) and EBITDA of EUR 56.6 million (up 28%). The company maintains BB+ credit ratings from both S&P Global and Fitch, and continues expansion through its shopping centres and residential development segment Galio Group.

top.title: Faster Permitting Paths Put Gold-Antimony Projects on Both Sides of the Pacific in Focus
top.summary: With China's antimony export suspension set to expire in November 2026 and global antimony prices elevated, governments in New Zealand and the United States are accelerating approvals for gold-antimony projects. RUA GOLD submitted its substantive application for the Auld Creek project in New Zealand under the Fast-track Approvals Act, targeting mid-2027 approvals. Nova Minerals received final permits for its Alaska antimony project with $43.4 million in Department of War funding, targeting 2027 production. United States Antimony Corporation began mining operations at Nolan Creek, while Perpetua Resources secured $40 million in additional U.S. Army funding for tungsten evaluation at Stibnite. Alkane Resources reported strong Q1 FY27 production of 39,823 ounces of gold and 396 tonnes of antimony.

top.summary: Dune, an onchain data platform, has completed a SOC 2 Type II examination with no exceptions, strengthening its credibility with institutional clients. Dune serves over 1,000 customers including major financial institutions and is positioning itself as the industry standard for institutional-grade blockchain data.
